primitives.name: Touchdown Marking
primitives.verbatim_quote: The Touchdown is marked at the point, not where the ball is carried across the line, but where the ball is declared dead by thé Referee.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P_d': 'point where ball is declared dead (meters)', 'L_g': 'goal line (meters)'}
primitives.assumptions: Ball trajectory is continuous and referee's declaration is deterministic.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When ball crosses goal line but is declared dead before crossing it.

layer2.mapping: Referee-declared dead state maps to geometric intersection of ball path and goal line.
layer2.telemetry: Ball position at time of referee call

primitives.name: Touchback Kick Intercept
primitives.verbatim_quote: It is a Touchback when a kicked ball (other\_than one from kick-off, free kick, or one scoring a goal from the field) goes over the goal line before being touched by a player of either side.
primitives.assumptions: Ball does not touch any player before crossing goal line.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Ball crosses goal line without player contact.

layer2.mapping: Trajectory intersection with goal line triggers touchback state transition.

primitives.name: Touchback Referee Boundary
primitives.verbatim_quote: It is a Touchback when a forward pass crosses either the end line or side line extended; when it strikes the goal posts or cross-bar, or when it touches the ground within the end zone.
primitives.assumptions: Pass trajectory intersects boundary or goal post before touching ground.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Pass crosses boundary or hits goalpost before ground contact.

layer2.mapping: Geometric boundary crossing maps to touchback state in GSE.
